name: 到期管家
description: Due dates and Apple Reminders with 188 offline SF Symbols, richer scene search and eight related icon recommendations, full notes and bounded foreground sync.

localizedDescriptions.en: 3.5.1 adds six iOS-17-compatible symbols for identity and driving licenses, passports and visas, certificates, dental and oral care, swimming, and vehicle maintenance, bringing the offline catalog to 188 while retaining all previous choices. Search now understands rent, property fees, contracts, vehicle inspections, medical follow-ups, loans, yoga, existing product names and related aliases. Eight recommendations combine the automatic and current icons with related scenes such as vehicles, VPN security, documents, housing and health. Search aliases do not broaden automatic inference; manual choices still take priority. Preview, confirmation, cancellation, full Reminder notes, dates, recurrence, completion, data safeguards and fixed updates remain unchanged. Actual widget updates remain scheduled by iOS.
localizedDescriptions.zh: 3.5.1 定向新增身份驾照、护照签证、证书资格、牙科口腔、游泳泳课及车辆保养 6 个兼容 iOS 17 的符号，目录增至 188 个，原有选择保留。搜索补充房租、物业、合同、年检、复诊、贷款、瑜伽及已有产品名称等别名；8 个推荐结合自动图标、当前选择与车辆、VPN 安全、证件、居家、健康等关联场景。搜索别名不扩大自动匹配，手选始终优先。预览确认、取消、完整提醒备注、日期、周期、完成、数据保护与固定更新地址不变。实际组件更新仍由 iOS 调度。

localizedDescriptions.zh-Hant: 3.5.1 定向新增身份駕照、護照簽證、證書資格、牙科口腔、游泳泳課及車輛保養 6 個相容 iOS 17 的符號，目錄增至 188 個，原有選擇保留。搜尋補充房租、物業、合同、年檢、複診、貸款、瑜伽及既有產品名稱等別名；8 個推薦結合自動圖示、目前選擇與車輛、VPN 安全、證件、居家、健康等關聯場景。搜尋別名不擴大自動匹配，手選始終優先。預覽確認、取消、完整提醒備註、日期、週期、完成、資料保護與固定更新地址不變。實際元件更新仍由 iOS 排程。
